official: 官方在线 2025-06-18 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Macro shocks produce high dispersion in firm-level equity returns, sales growth, and other outcomes.We show that this dispersion reflects observable differences in business characteristics.To do so, we combine firm-level returns on stock market ``jump" days with text about business risks in prior 10-K filings to construct firm-specific shock exposures.Our exposure measures explain firm-level abnormal returns through interpretable variation in language.They also explain most of the increased dispersion in firm-level revenue growth after major shocks and much of the dispersion in employment growth, investment rates, and earnings surprises.Our evidence yields a novel interpretation for countercyclical dispersion, highlighting the key role of heterogeneous business characteristics in macro shock transmission.
abstract_zh: 宏观冲击导致企业层面的股票回报率、销售增长及其他经营结果出现高度离散。我们证明，这种离散反映了企业特征中可观察到的差异。为此，我们将股票市场“跳跃”日的企业层面回报与先前10-K文件中的业务风险文本相结合，构建企业特定的冲击暴露度指标。我们的暴露度衡量指标通过语言中可解释的变化，解释了企业层面的异常回报。这些指标还解释了重大冲击后企业层面收入增长离散度增加的大部分，以及就业增长、投资率和盈利惊喜离散度的很大一部分。我们的证据为逆周期离散提供了新的解释，强调了异质性企业特征在宏观冲击传导中的关键作用。

title: Regional services trade agreements and upgrading in global value chains: an analysis from the network perspective

authors: Xinyi Zeng, Yue Pu, Xing Yao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Against the backdrop of economic globalization, relationships among countries established through regional services trade agreements (services RTAs) have become increasingly complex. Assessing a country’s global value chain (GVC) position requires considering its place within the network of services RTAs formed with other economies. Using data from 60 countries for the period 2007–2021, this study estimates the impact of the services RTA network, with network linkages weighted by agreement depth, on countries’ GVC positions. The results indicate that the expansion and deepening of the services RTA network significantly promote the upgrading of countries’ GVC positions, and the conclusion is robust. This positive effect operates primarily through three channels: reductions in services trade costs, technology spillovers, and adjustments to production length. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that the positive effect of the services RTA network on GVC upgrading is more pronounced in North-North and North-South cooperation as well as in multilateral agreements, and that this effect varies across sectors. This study contributes to understanding how the services RTA network affects the development of global value chains and provides insights for countries seeking to improve their services trade policies. title: Do Cultural Exports Shape Country Image? Evidence From Chinese Film Releases and Global Media Data

title_primary: 文化出口是否塑造国家形象？来自中国电影发行与全球媒体数据的证据

authors: Feng Liu, Meina Zheng, Xiaokang Wu, Meichang Wang, Yanqi Jin
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates how Chinese film exports shape international perceptions of China and associated economic outcomes, drawing on high‐frequency media data from the Global Database of Events, Language and Tone. We match the overseas release dates of 906 Chinese films across more than 120 countries to 355,867 media reports spanning April 2013 to October 2025, treating release timing as a quasi‐natural experiment. A difference‐in‐differences design identifies the causal effect of film exposure on country image, proxied by the sentiment of local media coverage. Baseline estimates indicate that releases produce a statistically significant improvement in the average tone of China‐related reporting, a result that withstands an extensive battery of sensitivity checks. The effect is modest in magnitude, consistent with the limited overseas box‐office reach of most Chinese films, and concentrated in the short run, operating chiefly by altering the surrounding media information environment rather than through mass theatrical viewership. Heterogeneity analyses reveal stronger responses in culturally proximate settings, middle‐ and high‐income economies, Belt and Road Initiative partners, and contexts where prior sentiment toward China is comparatively favourable, with international co‐productions and higher‐rated films yielding larger gains. Mechanism evidence shows that exposure heightens public attention and information‐seeking, thereby fostering more positive evaluations. These improvements carry economically meaningful consequences, including increased imports from China and enhanced appeal as a destination for international students. Because gains accrue primarily among already favourable audiences, the findings suggest a reinforcement rather than persuasion mechanism, illustrating both the potential and the constraints of film as a soft‐power instrument.
abstract_zh: 本文利用全球事件、语言与语调数据库中的高频媒体数据，考察中国电影出口如何塑造国际社会对中国的认知及其相关经济后果。我们将906部中国电影在120多个国家的海外上映日期与2013年4月至2025年10月间的355,867篇媒体报道进行匹配，并将上映时点视为准自然实验。通过双重差分设计，我们识别出电影曝光对国家形象（以当地媒体报道情感倾向为代理变量）的因果效应。基准估计表明，电影上映显著改善了涉华报道的平均语调，且该结果在大量敏感性检验中保持稳健。效应幅度较为温和，与多数中国电影有限的海外票房影响力相符，且集中于短期，主要通过改变周边媒体信息环境而非大规模影院观影发挥作用。异质性分析显示，在文化相近情境、中高收入经济体、“一带一路”倡议伙伴国以及先前对华情感相对友好的环境中，响应更为显著；国际合拍片和评分较高的电影带来更大增益。机制证据表明，电影曝光提升了公众关注度和信息搜寻行为，从而促进更积极的评价。这些改善具有经济层面的实质意义，包括增加从中国的进口以及提升作为国际学生目的地的吸引力。由于增益主要集中于本就持友好态度的受众群体，研究结果提示一种强化而非说服机制，既展示了电影作为软实力工具的潜力，也揭示了其局限性。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the effect of skilled foreign labor on corporate investment using two natural experiments involving the H-1B visa program. First, we exploit the randomized lottery for allocating H-1B visas and show that firms with higher lottery success rates increase their post-lottery investments. The effect is stronger for firms hiring higher-wage workers in occupations that are not easily offshorable, consistent with a skilled labor access channel. Second, we exploit the uncertain timing of the H-1B application deadline and show that firms reduce their investments when their visa applications are rendered unexpectedly ineligible due to labor certification processing times.

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Multiple land rights holders and layered land rights structures create fundamental challenges for implementing land-based financing methods such as land value capture (LVC). In a decentralized governance system, overlapping land rights and fragmented planning complicate coordination and limit the effectiveness of LVC for financing transport infrastructure development. This study examines how different rights holders contribute to implementing land value capture within a layered land rights and multi-level governance system in Indonesia, using the Jakarta Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) project as a case study. In Indonesia’s decentralized system, multiple levels of government apply different planning tools to regulate land use and development, complicating coordination between planning, land rights, and LVC mechanisms. Qualitative data from semi-structured interviews and policy analysis show that overlapping land rights and fragmented regulations create legal and administrative uncertainty. This uncertainty acts as a barrier to cross-governmental coordination and private stakeholder engagement, both of which are necessary for a workable LVC framework. Although a formal LVC framework exists, unclear rules on which rights holders should contribute, combined with complex administrative procedures, limit its practical use. This study contributes to the LVC literature by linking instruments to specific land rights holders and by extending the bundle-of-rights perspective. It explains why LVC remains underutilized in contexts with layered land rights and decentralized governance. The findings highlight the need for policy reforms to clarify contribution obligations, improve coordination across governance levels, and simplify the administrative process.
abstract_zh: 多重土地权利主体与分层土地权利结构，为实施土地价值捕获（LVC）等土地融资方式带来了根本性挑战。在分散化治理体系下，土地权利重叠与规划碎片化使协调工作复杂化，并限制了LVC在交通基础设施发展融资中的有效性。本研究以雅加达大众快速交通（MRT）项目为案例，考察在印度尼西亚分层土地权利与多层治理体系中，不同权利主体如何参与土地价值捕获的实施。在印度尼西亚的分散化体制下，多级政府运用不同的规划工具来规范土地利用与开发，这使得规划、土地权利与LVC机制之间的协调更加复杂。基于半结构化访谈与政策分析的定性数据表明，土地权利重叠与法规碎片化造成了法律和行政层面的不确定性。这种不确定性成为跨政府协调与私营利益相关方参与的障碍，而这两者均为可行的LVC框架所必需。尽管存在正式的LVC框架，但关于哪些权利主体应承担贡献义务的规则不明确，加之复杂的行政程序，限制了其实际应用。本研究通过将工具与特定土地权利主体相联系，并拓展权利束视角，为LVC文献作出贡献。研究解释了为何在分层土地权利与分散化治理背景下，LVC仍未被充分利用。研究结果凸显了政策改革的必要性，以明确贡献义务、改善跨治理层级的协调，并简化行政程序。

abstract: We combine detailed information on US temporary trade barriers during 1989-2020 with input-output data to study the effects of trade protection along supply chains. We focus on measures imposed against China, which has been the main target of trade protection during the last decades. To deal with endogeneity concerns, we use an instrumental variable strategy, exploiting changes in the identity of swing states across presidential terms and heterogeneous exposure to these political shocks across industries. We find that politically motivated trade protection generates winners and losers: it fosters employment growth in protected industries, but hampers employment growth in downstream industries.

abstract: Consumers make transactions of different sizes over time. This paper shows that this fact, together with transaction costs of various assets, can help in developing a theory of liquidity. Assets with different cost structures are used to purchase different sizes of transactions. This can explain the demand for money itself, the precautionary demand for money, and the demand for cash and demand deposits. Thus consumers use cash for small transactions, demand deposits for larger transactions, and use savings for the largest transactions. Finally, the paper shows that modeling banks as suppliers of liquidity leads to a better understanding of their success as financial intermediaries.

abstract: This paper analyses corporate risk choice when firms and their managers have private information regarding firm quality. Managers ? representing themselves or shareholders ? have a short time horizon and wish to boost the firm?s reputation in the market. Investors observe the firm?s current earnings to assess firm quality. Each firm has an opportunity locus for trading off risk and expected return. We show that even risk-neutral managers will choose risk strategically to influence market perceptions. Our model employs the following sequence: (1) a manager learns the firm?s type (good or bad), which determines its opportunity locus relating to risk and expected return; (2) the manager selects a level of risk; (3) a period payoff is reaped; (4) potential purchasers of the firm draw inferences from the period payoff; and (5) the firm is sold in a competitive auction. If firms? choices of risk are observed by the market, pooling behaviour results. Among the pooling equilibria, we show that good firms prefer those with lower variance, which reveal more information, whereas bad firms prefer higher variance equilibria. If risk level choices can only be partially observed, as we expect, and if the market has no strong prior belief about whether firms are good or bad, then good firms will hedge and bad firms will gamble. The latter seek to masquerade as good firms; good firms in turn seek to distinguish themselves. If the market?s prior beliefs are highly unfavourable (favourable), both types gamble (hedge) hoping to alter (avoid refuting) these beliefs. Our empirical evidence confirms our theoretical results when risk choices are not fully observed. Firms with higher returns on assets have less variable performance.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了当企业及其管理者拥有关于企业质量的私人信息时，企业的风险选择行为。管理者——无论是代表自身还是股东——具有短期视野，并希望提升企业在市场中的声誉。投资者通过观察企业当前收益来评估企业质量。每个企业都面临风险与预期收益之间的权衡机会集。研究表明，即使是风险中性的管理者也会策略性地选择风险以影响市场认知。我们的模型采用以下顺序：（1）管理者获知企业类型（优质或劣质），该类型决定了其风险与预期收益的机会集；（2）管理者选择风险水平；（3）获得期间收益；（4）企业潜在购买者根据期间收益进行推断；（5）企业通过竞争性拍卖出售。若市场可观测到企业的风险选择，则会产生趋同行为。在趋同均衡中，优质企业偏好方差较低的均衡（能揭示更多信息），而劣质企业则偏好方差较高的均衡。若风险水平选择仅能被部分观测（如预期所示），且市场对企业优劣无强烈先验信念，则优质企业会进行对冲，劣质企业会进行赌博。后者试图伪装成优质企业，而优质企业则力求区分自身。若市场先验信念极为不利（有利），则两类企业均会赌博（对冲），以期改变（避免否定）这些信念。当风险选择未被完全观测时，我们的实证证据证实了理论结果：资产收益率较高的企业，其业绩波动性较低。

abstract: This paper proposes a model of tax compliance and fiscal capacity grounded in universalization reasoning. Citizens partially internalize the consequences of concealment by imagining a world in which everyone acted similarly, linking their compliance decisions to the perceived effectiveness of public spending. A selfish elite chooses between public goods and private rents, taking compliance as given. In equilibrium, citizens' moral internalization expands the feasible tax base and induces elites to allocate resources toward provision rather than appropriation. When the value of public spending is uncertain, morality enables credible reform: high-value elites can signal their type through provision, prompting citizens to increase compliance and raising fiscal capacity within the same period. The analysis thus identifies a moral channel through which states may escape low-capacity traps even under weak institutions.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一个基于普遍化推理的税收遵从与财政能力模型。公民通过想象一个所有人行为相似的世界，部分内化隐瞒行为的后果，从而将自身的税收遵从决策与公共支出的感知有效性联系起来。自私的精英阶层在给定税收遵从水平的情况下，在公共品与私人租金之间进行选择。在均衡状态下，公民的道德内化扩大了可行的税基，并促使精英阶层将资源分配给公共品供给而非私人侵占。当公共支出的价值不确定时，道德因素能够促成可信的改革：高价值精英可以通过提供公共品来传递自身类型信号，促使公民提高税收遵从度，并在同一时期内提升财政能力。因此，本文分析揭示了一条道德渠道——即便在制度薄弱的情况下，国家也可能通过该渠道摆脱低财政能力陷阱。

abstract: Discrete policy thresholds are pervasive in tax and regulatory systems and can substantially distort behavior. We show that notches acting as barriers to mobility within a distribution generate distortions extending far beyond the threshold. The same mechanism biases conventional difference-in-differences estimators, and we propose a new methodology to recover causal effects. Applying the method to the abolition of a size-based payroll tax notch, we find that the notch reduced the number of firms above the threshold by 18 percent and lowered treated firms’ employment, capital stock, and value added by 10 percent, whereas conventional difference-in-differences estimates imply negligible effects.
abstract_zh: 离散政策阈值在税收和监管体系中普遍存在，并可能显著扭曲行为。我们证明，作为分布内流动性障碍的阈值缺口所产生的扭曲效应远超阈值本身。同一机制会导致传统双重差分估计量产生偏误，为此我们提出一种恢复因果效应的新方法。将该方法应用于基于企业规模的工资税缺口废除案例，我们发现该缺口使阈值以上企业数量减少18%，并导致受处理企业的就业、资本存量和增加值下降10%，而传统双重差分估计显示的影响可忽略不计。

abstract: We show that the formalization of representativeness (Kahneman and Tversky (1972)) developed by Gennaioli and Shleifer (2010) features an intrinsic connection between uncertainty and overreaction. In the time series domain, we develop this connection in a smooth version of Diagnostic Expectations (DE), where overreaction varies smoothly with uncertainty. Intuitively, under smoothness, lower uncertainty leaves less room for representativeness to distort beliefs. Smooth DE provides a joint, parsimonious micro-foundation for key features of survey data: overreaction to news, stronger overreaction at longer horizons, overconfidence in subjective uncertainty, and a new stylized fact documented here—overreaction intensifies with higher uncertainty. An analytical Real Business Cycle model with Smooth DE accounts for survey overreaction and overconfidence, as well as three salient business cycle properties: asymmetry, countercyclical macro volatility, and countercyclical micro volatility.
abstract_zh: 我们表明，Gennaioli 和 Shleifer（2010）对 Kahneman 和 Tversky（1972）所提出的代表性概念的形式化，与不确定性和过度反应之间存在内在联系。在时间序列领域，我们在诊断性预期（DE）的平滑版本中发展了这一联系，其中过度反应随不确定性平滑变化。直观而言，在平滑条件下，较低的不确定性为代表性扭曲信念留下的空间更小。平滑诊断性预期为调查数据的若干关键特征提供了统一且简约的微观基础：对新闻的过度反应、在更长期限上更强的过度反应、对主观不确定性的过度自信，以及本文记录的一个新典型事实，即不确定性越高，过度反应越强。一个结合平滑诊断性预期的解析性真实经济周期模型，既能解释调查数据中的过度反应和过度自信，也能解释商业周期的三个显著特征：不对称性、宏观波动的逆周期性以及微观波动的逆周期性。

abstract: State honours are designed as symbols of merit and public recognition. But they may also convey information with economic value. This column explores the market value of the Légion d’honneur. When corporate directors of French listed firms receive the honour, their companies’ share prices rise. This market reaction is concentrated among directors without a publicly observable educational link to members of the incumbent government before the award. The pattern suggests that state distinctions can provide investors with new information about a director’s potential access to policymakers.
abstract_zh: 国家荣誉旨在作为功绩和公众认可的象征，但它们也可能传递具有经济价值的信息。本文探讨了荣誉军团勋章的市场价值。当法国上市公司的董事获得该荣誉时，其所在公司的股价会上涨。这种市场反应主要集中在那些在获奖前与现任政府成员没有公开可观察的教育关联的董事身上。这一模式表明，国家荣誉能够为投资者提供关于董事接触政策制定者可能性的新信息。

abstract: We study communication frictions within multinationals (MNCs), hypothesizing that language barriers reduce management knowledge transfers within the organization. A distinct feature of such MNCs is a three-tier hierarchy: foreign managers (FMs) supervise domestic managers (DMs) who supervise production workers. Tailored surveys from our setting—MNCs in Myanmar—reveal that language barriers impede interactions between FMs and DMs. A first experimental protocol offers DMs free English courses and confirms that lowering communications costs increases their interactions with FMs. A second experimental protocol that asks human-resource managers at domestic firms to rate hypothetical resumes reveals that multinational experience and, specifically, DM-FM interactions are valued in the domestic labor market. Together, these results suggest that reducing language barriers can improve transfers of management knowledge, an interpretation supported by improvements in soft skills among treatment DMs in the first experiment. A model in which communication within MNCs is noncontractible—a realistic feature of workplace life—reveals that the experimental results are consistent with underinvestment in language training and provide a rationale for policy intervention.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了跨国公司内部的沟通摩擦，假设语言障碍会减少组织内部管理知识的转移。这类跨国公司的一个显著特征是三级层级结构：外籍经理（FMs）监督本地经理（DMs），而本地经理则监督生产工人。基于缅甸跨国公司的定制调查显示，语言障碍阻碍了外籍经理与本地经理之间的互动。第一项实验方案为本地经理提供免费英语课程，并证实降低沟通成本能增加他们与外籍经理的互动。第二项实验方案要求国内企业的人力资源经理对假设简历进行评分，结果表明跨国经验，特别是本地经理与外籍经理的互动，在国内劳动力市场中受到重视。综合来看，这些结果表明减少语言障碍可以改善管理知识的转移，这一解释得到了第一项实验中接受培训的本地经理软技能提升的支持。一个将跨国公司内部沟通视为不可契约化的模型——这是职场生活的现实特征——揭示了实验结果与语言培训投资不足的一致性，并为政策干预提供了理论依据。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Does an exchange rate depreciation depress trading partners’ output? I address this question through the lens of a classic episode: from 1931 to 1936, the largest economies in the world successively devalued their currency. In theory, the effect is ambiguous for countries that had not devalued: expenditure switching can lower their output, but the monetary stimulus to foreign demand might raise it. Newly constructed high-frequency devaluation shocks and a multi-country model disciplined by cross-sectional evidence concur. Contrary to the popular narrative in modern policy debates, devaluation did not dramatically lower the output of trading partners in this context. Meanwhile, devaluation substantially raised the output of the devaluing country itself: it was a potent stimulus, not a zero-sum game.
abstract_zh: 汇率贬值是否会抑制贸易伙伴的产出？本文通过一个经典历史案例来探讨这一问题：1931年至1936年间，全球主要经济体相继实施货币贬值。理论上，对于未贬值国家而言，其影响具有不确定性：支出转换效应可能降低其产出，但外国需求受到的货币刺激则可能提升产出。基于新构建的高频贬值冲击数据以及受横截面证据约束的多国模型，研究结果趋于一致。与现代政策辩论中的流行叙事相反，在此背景下，贬值并未显著降低贸易伙伴的产出。与此同时，贬值大幅提升了贬值国自身的产出：这是一剂强有力的经济刺激措施，而非零和博弈。

abstract: We show that incorporating uninsurable countercyclical income risk into a standard international RBC model can qualitatively and quantitatively account for the quantity puzzles in open-economy macro, namely (i) the Backus-Smith puzzle, (ii) the Backus-Kehoe-Kydland puzzle and (iii) the weak correlation between the trade balance and the exchange rate. We also show that our model can simultaneously account for the Fama puzzle and the evidence that high interest rate countries have stronger currencies—which representative-agents models that rely only on financial or demand shocks cannot jointly account for. Crucially, our model resolves all these puzzles while relying solely on productivity shocks, and thus generates the observed domestic and cross-country macroeconomic comovement.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，将不可保险的反周期收入风险纳入标准国际实际经济周期模型，能够从定性和定量两方面解释开放经济宏观经济学中的数量谜题，即：（i）巴克斯-史密斯谜题、（ii）巴克斯-基欧-基德兰德谜题以及（iii）贸易余额与汇率之间的弱相关性。我们还证明，该模型能同时解释法玛谜题以及高利率国家拥有更强货币的证据——而仅依赖金融或需求冲击的代表性主体模型无法共同解释这些现象。关键在于，我们的模型仅依靠生产率冲击就解决了所有谜题，从而生成了观察到的国内及跨国宏观经济协同波动。

title: Impact of Water Quality Regulation on the Agricultural Economy in China
title_zh: 水质监管对中国农业经济的影响

authors: Ding Li, Ziran Li, Shuai Shao, Chenxi Yu, Wendong Zhang
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-06-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Agricultural production is a major contributor to water pollution in China and increasingly subject to regulation. However, the effectiveness of such regulation—particularly for non-point source pollution—remains underexplored. This paper estimates the causal effects of environmental enforcement on agricultural outcomes using a spatial regression discontinuity design based on China's surface water quality monitoring network. Monitoring stations only register pollution from upstream sources, creating sharp spatial variation in regulatory pressure. After water quality performance was linked to political promotions in 2003, upstream counties experienced a significant decline in agricultural value added—about 58% lower than downstream neighbors. No such gap existed before the reform. The effect is robust to placebo tests, bandwidth changes, a difference-in-discontinuities design, and an instrumental variables strategy using hydrological station placement. To explore the channels through which regulation affects agricultural outcomes, we combine administrative data, household survey microdata, remote sensing, and emissions inventories. We find that upstream counties hired fewer agricultural workers, cultivated less land, and applied less fertilizer. Rural households in upstream counties are also more likely to migrate across counties, consistent with declining local agricultural viability. Remote sensing data confirm broad reductions in crop planting areas. N2O emission inventory data show accompanying reductions in N2O from both agricultural soils and manure. These results show that China water quality regulation can alter input use, land allocation, and emissions in agriculture. However, enforcement may also displace rural labor and reshape household decisions, highlighting important trade-offs in implementing environmental policy in developing country contexts.
abstract_zh: 农业生产是中国水污染的主要来源之一，并日益受到法规的约束。然而，此类法规的有效性——尤其是针对非点源污染的法规——仍未得到充分探讨。本文利用基于中国地表水质监测网络的空间断点回归设计，估计了环境执法对农业产出的因果效应。监测站仅记录上游来源的污染，从而在监管压力上形成了显著的空间差异。自2003年水质绩效与官员政治晋升挂钩后，上游县农业增加值显著下降，比下游邻县低约58%。而改革前并无此差距。该效应在安慰剂检验、带宽调整、断点差异设计以及利用水文站点布局作为工具变量的策略中均保持稳健。为探究法规影响农业产出的渠道，我们结合了行政数据、住户调查微观数据、遥感影像及排放清单。研究发现，上游县雇佣的农业劳动力减少，耕地面积缩减，化肥施用量下降。上游县农村家庭也更倾向于跨县迁移，这与当地农业生存能力下降相符。遥感数据证实了作物种植面积的大幅减少。N2O排放清单数据显示，农业土壤和粪便中的N2O排放相应减少。这些结果表明，中国的水质法规能够改变农业中的投入品使用、土地配置及排放。然而，执法也可能导致农村劳动力转移并重塑家庭决策，凸显了在发展中国家实施环境政策时需权衡的重要取舍。

title: The Targets of Geoeconomic Coercion
title_zh: 地缘经济胁迫的目标
title_primary: 地缘经济胁迫的目标

authors: Christopher Clayton, Matteo Maggiori, Jesse Schreger
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Great powers, like the United States and China, use existing trade and financial linkages of their economies to the rest of the world to exert geoeconomic power. The targeted entities include both foreign governments and foreign private firms. We characterize conditions under which a hegemonic country optimally targets private entities or their government in a given targeted foreign country. An advantage of coercing private entities is that they internalize less than their own government the equilibrium consequences of acquiescing to the hegemon's coercion. This allows the hegemon to build its power by exploiting the difference between the private cost to the targeted entity of the costly actions it demands and the social value to the hegemon of those actions. Coercing the government gives up some of this advantage, but offers the ability of having the targeted government potentially influence firms in its domestic economy that the hegemon finds valuable to coerce but for which it had limited direct coercive power. The relative strength of these two channels determines the optimal mix of coercion targeted at private entities and governments.
abstract_zh: 大国（如美国和中国）利用其经济与全球其他地区的既有贸易和金融联系来施加地缘经济影响力。其目标实体既包括外国政府，也包括外国私营企业。我们刻画了霸权国在特定目标外国中，最优选择针对私营实体或该国政府进行胁迫的条件。胁迫私营实体的优势在于：相较于目标国政府，私营实体对屈服于霸权国胁迫所产生的均衡后果内化程度更低。这使得霸权国能够利用其要求目标实体采取的高成本行动所产生的私人成本，与这些行动对霸权国的社会价值之间的差异来构建自身权力。胁迫政府虽会部分丧失这一优势，但能使目标国政府影响其国内经济中那些霸权国认为有价值胁迫、但自身直接胁迫能力有限的企业。这两个渠道的相对强弱决定了针对私营实体与政府的最优胁迫组合。

abstract: This paper analyses drought severity across Mexican regions between 2000 and 2025 using satellite-based indicators of vegetation health and surface moisture. Unlike traditional station-based measures, which depend on sparse weather data and often involve reporting delays, this approach directly captures how ecosystems respond to water stress across the entire territory. By combining these signals into a regional Normalised Difference Drought Index, the study provides a consistent, high-resolution measure of drought intensity for all Mexican states, identifying both the location and severity of water stress. The methodology enables detection of drought conditions at a finer spatial scale than conventional indicators, revealing substantial intra-state variation, such as the contrasts observed within Querétaro. The results show a persistent north–south divide: northern states, characterised by arid and semi-arid climates, experience more frequent and severe droughts, while southern regions retain higher levels of vegetation and moisture. From an economic and fiscal perspective, these patterns point to greater vulnerability in the north, where water-intensive agricultural, industrial, and energy sectors are concentrated. The findings underscore the value of near-real-time, spatially detailed monitoring to support Mexico’s climate adaptation policies and to inform the development of fiscal resilience mechanisms to mitigate climate-related risks. authors: Kohei Daido, Tomoya Tajika
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how interpersonal information projection bias influences a researcher’s decision to implement a current idea or to continue drawing new ones. Consistent misbeliefs, such as overconfidence or underconfidence, distort beliefs in a fixed manner. In contrast, information projection creates state-dependent beliefs: before an idea arises, the researcher is optimistic about its uniqueness, and once the idea is in hand, the researcher becomes pessimistic. This fluctuation makes implementation less attractive and makes repeated searches more appealing. Our analysis yields two key findings. First, compared to any consistent-misbelief researcher whose fixed belief falls between the optimistic and pessimistic assessments of the information projection researcher, the information projection researcher is more selective: implementing less, drawing more ideas, and quitting less frequently. Second, at sufficiently high performance thresholds, researchers who end up passing the threshold are disproportionately information projection researchers. Consequently, information projection systematically biases both individual search dynamics and the composition of such researchers.
abstract_zh: 我们研究人际信息投射偏差如何影响研究者决定实施当前想法还是继续构思新想法。一致的错误信念，如过度自信或信心不足，会以固定方式扭曲信念。相比之下，信息投射产生依赖于状态的信念：在想法出现之前，研究者对其独特性持乐观态度；而一旦想法在手，研究者则变得悲观。这种波动使得实施想法的吸引力降低，而重复搜索则更具吸引力。我们的分析得出两个关键发现。首先，与任何固定信念介于信息投射研究者乐观与悲观评估之间的一致错误信念研究者相比，信息投射研究者更具选择性：实施更少、构思更多、放弃频率更低。其次，在足够高的绩效门槛下，最终通过门槛的研究者中，信息投射研究者占比不成比例地高。因此，信息投射系统性地偏差了个体搜索动态以及此类研究者的构成。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study investigates the temporal and contextual stability of social risk preferences across health and wealth, focusing on both gains and losses. Using a large representative Dutch panel, we replicated the experimental design of Attema et al. (2023) which elicited social risk preferences through allocation decisions involving two anonymous recipients under risk. The design allows us to distinguish three dimensions of preferences: risk preferences, inequality aversion, and social risk preferences arising from trade-offs between risk and inequality, corresponding to utilitarian, ex-ante, and ex-post perspectives on social welfare. At the aggregate level, the main patterns documented in the original study are largely replicated: inequality aversion is prevalent and risk aversion is weaker in the loss domain than in the gain domain. At the individual level, however, stability is more limited. Test-retest correlations are positive but modest, and the proportion of identical choices across waves varies across domains and framings. Parametric estimations further reveal substantial heterogeneity in social risk preferences. A latent-class analysis identifies utilitarian preferences as the largest group, followed by ex-post and exante perspectives. Overall, the results highlight the coexistence of persistence, contextual effects, and heterogeneity in social risk preferences
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了社会风险偏好在健康与财富领域中的时间稳定性与情境稳定性，重点关注收益与损失两种情境。基于荷兰大型代表性面板数据，我们复现了Attema等人（2023）的实验设计，该设计通过涉及两名匿名受助者在风险条件下的分配决策来测度社会风险偏好。该设计允许我们区分偏好的三个维度：风险偏好、不平等厌恶，以及由风险与不平等权衡产生的社会风险偏好，分别对应社会福利的功利主义、事前与事后视角。在总体层面，原始研究记录的主要模式基本得到复现：不平等厌恶普遍存在，且损失域中的风险厌恶程度弱于收益域。然而在个体层面，稳定性较为有限。重测相关性呈正值但幅度较小，不同轮次间完全一致的选择比例因领域与框架而异。参数估计进一步揭示了社会风险偏好的显著异质性。潜在类别分析显示，功利主义偏好群体规模最大，其次为事后与事前视角群体。总体而言，研究结果凸显了社会风险偏好中持续性、情境效应与异质性的共存特征。

abstract: This paper presents results from a field experiment in Nigeria in which expectant mothers were offered cash payments of N2500, N4000 or N10000 conditioned on using formal medical care. A secondary intervention provided some mothers with an information signal about their pregnancy risk. We find highly non-linear effects of conditional payments—most of the incentive effect occurs on the extensive margin, with rapidly diminishing returns to incentive size. We also uncover new spillover effects: showing that incentives increase healthcare use in childhood by index children and by other children in the household. We find largely null effects of the information signal.
abstract_zh: 本文报告了在尼日利亚进行的一项实地实验的结果，该实验向孕妇提供N2500、N4000或N10000的现金支付，条件是利用正规医疗服务。一项次级干预措施向部分孕妇提供了关于其妊娠风险的信息信号。我们发现，有条件支付的效果呈高度非线性——大部分激励效应发生在广泛边际上，且激励规模带来的回报迅速递减。我们还发现了新的溢出效应：激励措施增加了指数儿童及家庭中其他儿童在童年时期的医疗保健使用。我们发现信息信号的效果基本为零。

abstract: This paper investigates how kinship and professional networks shaped labour market outcomes in the guild‐based labour market of early modern Genoa. Using a newly constructed dataset of more than 8,000 apprenticeship contracts (1451–1530), I examine the extent to which family and guild connections influenced apprentices' chances of attaining mastership. Using a probabilistic record‐linkage strategy to reconstruct individual career trajectories, I show that apprentices embedded in kinship or guild networks were substantially more likely to become masters. These advantages operated through multiple channels, including shorter apprenticeship contracts and greater flexibility in training careers, and persisted even during periods of economic contraction, suggesting that apprenticeship in Genoa combined formally open access to training with strong informal mechanisms that structured advancement within skilled trades. The findings contribute to debates on the role of guilds and social networks in pre‐industrial labour markets, highlighting how institutions could simultaneously support skill formation and reproduce inequality.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在近代早期热那亚的行会劳动力市场中，亲属关系与职业网络如何塑造劳动力市场结果。利用新构建的包含8000余份学徒契约（1451–1530年）的数据集，我考察了家庭与行会关系对学徒获得师傅资格的影响程度。通过采用概率性记录关联策略重建个体职业轨迹，我发现嵌入亲属或行会网络的学徒成为师傅的可能性显著更高。这些优势通过多种渠道发挥作用，包括更短的学徒契约期限和更灵活的职业培训路径，并且即使在经济收缩时期依然持续存在。这表明热那亚的学徒制度将正式开放的培训准入与塑造技能行业晋升路径的强有力非正式机制相结合。研究结论为关于前工业劳动力市场中行会与社会网络作用的讨论提供了新视角，揭示了制度如何同时支持技能形成并再生产不平等。

abstract: In a simple lending model with informational asymmetry, we investigate the effect of bank market structure on the amount of collateral provided by firms. We analyze the strategic decision of a potential entrepreneur regarding the amount of wealth to pledge as collateral to secure a loan. The novel result is that the equilibrium collateral can be lower in a monopoly market than under perfect competition. A policy intervention designed to enhance lending is always Pareto-improving in a monopoly but not in a competitive banking industry, even though the associated policy costs are lower in the latter setting.
abstract_zh: 在存在信息不对称的简单借贷模型中，我们探讨了银行市场结构对企业提供的抵押品数量的影响。我们分析了一个潜在企业家在决定以多少财富作为抵押以获得贷款时的战略选择。新颖的结论是，在垄断市场中的均衡抵押品可能低于完全竞争市场。旨在促进贷款的政策干预在垄断市场中总是帕累托改进的，但在竞争性银行行业中并非如此，尽管在后者情境下相关的政策成本更低。

official: 官方在线 2026-04-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We evaluate alternative options for rebating revenues from a unilateral emissions price, focusing on emissions-intensive and trade-exposed industries. First, we develop a two-region and two-sector general equilibrium model and use it to demonstrate that rebating emission pricing revenues towards output increases and emission intensity reductions may be welfare-improving. These rebates are beneficial when emissions leakage and terms-of-trade changes are associated with the introduction of an emissions price, or when political constraints prevent the emissions price from fully reflecting the social cost of the emissions. We use a multi-region and multi-sector numerical simulation model to quantify the differences in welfare, leakage, terms of trade, output, and emissions across carbon prices with alternative rebating options for emissions-intensive and trade-exposed industries. The quantitative results indicate that from a domestic perspective, rebating emissions revenues proportionately to firm output is typically superior to other rebating options when the emissions price is set close to the social cost of emissions. Rebating emissions pricing revenues to reward reductions in emissions intensity is typically superior when emissions are significantly under-priced. A country that is more emissions-intensive and less exposed to leakage may prefer to rebate in proportion to total abatement when the emissions price is sufficiently low. The analysis highlights that incorrect choices of the rebating option can lead to substantial welfare losses.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了单边排放定价收入返还的替代方案，重点关注排放密集型且易受贸易影响的行业。首先，我们构建了一个两区域、两部门的一般均衡模型，并利用该模型证明，将排放定价收入返还用于促进产出增长和降低排放强度可能有助于提升福利。当排放定价导致排放泄漏和贸易条件变化，或当政治约束使排放价格无法完全反映排放的社会成本时，此类返还具有积极意义。我们采用多区域、多部门数值模拟模型，量化了不同碳价水平下，针对排放密集型且易受贸易影响行业的替代返还方案在福利、泄漏、贸易条件、产出和排放方面的差异。定量结果表明，从国内视角看，当排放价格设定接近社会成本时，按企业产出比例返还排放收入通常优于其他返还方案；而当排放价格显著偏低时，按排放强度降低幅度返还排放收入则更具优势。对于排放强度较高且泄漏风险较低的国家，若排放价格足够低，可能更倾向于按总减排量比例进行返还。分析强调，返还方案选择不当可能导致显著的福利损失。

title: A series of (un)fortunate events: Commercial bank interest rates and deposit reallocation during the Great Depression in the Netherlands

authors: Ruben Peeters, Amaury de Vicq de Cumptich
official: 官方在线 2025-12-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract During the global economic crisis of 1929–33, deposits in the Dutch commercial banking sector sharply declined as funds shifted to the government‐guaranteed Post Office Savings Bank and other savings institutions. Unlike earlier studies for neighbouring countries, we demonstrate that this shift was driven less by a flight to safety and more by a reduction in long‐term interest rates on savings accounts offered by commercial banks, whilst the rates offered by the Post Office Savings Bank remained stable. Through a series of policy measures resembling financial repression, the Dutch government actively encouraged this shift to ensure a steady demand for government debt amongst savings institutions. As the demand for loans decreased, commercial banks managed to retain their profitability by reducing lending to smaller, less profitable businesses, as evidenced by higher minimum loan sizes, a preference for existing clients over new ones, and increased requirements for tangible collateral. This strategic move to eliminate less profitable loans from their portfolios enabled banks to weather the period with minimal damage and prevent an outright banking crisis, but it did contribute to a substantial reduction in private credit.
abstract_zh: 摘要 在1929年至1933年的全球经济危机期间，荷兰商业银行部门的存款急剧下降，资金转向由政府担保的邮政储蓄银行及其他储蓄机构。与先前针对邻国的研究不同，我们证明，这一转变更多是由商业银行储蓄账户长期利率下降所驱动，而非出于避险行为，而邮政储蓄银行提供的利率则保持稳定。通过一系列类似金融压制的政策措施，荷兰政府积极推动这一转变，以确保储蓄机构对政府债务的稳定需求。随着贷款需求减少，商业银行通过减少对较小、利润较低企业的贷款来维持盈利能力，这体现在最低贷款额度的提高、偏好现有客户而非新客户，以及对有形抵押品要求的增加。这一战略性举措，即从投资组合中剔除利润较低的贷款，使银行得以在最小损失下度过该时期，并避免了一场全面的银行业危机，但确实导致了私人信贷的大幅缩减。
